criteria.description: Reads the shape of the retention curve — recognizes it decays toward zero (no flattening), signalling weak durable value, rather than just restating the percentages.
Compares cohorts over time and notes retention is NOT improving across A/B/C (no cohort-over-cohort gain).
Diagnoses this as a retention/leaky-bucket problem (3x signups, flat revenue) and warns against scaling paid acquisition into a non-retaining product.
Recommends segmenting to find any retaining group and prioritizing retention/activation work, with a concrete next step.
Notes how 'active' is defined and/or other caveats affecting the read.
